title: SKUAST-K trains participants in detection and prevention of Zoonotic diseases under One Health Initiative

ai.summary: SKUAST-K organised a one-day workshop on zoonotic disease prevention under One Health initiative, focusing on practical training and interdisciplinary collaboration.

facts.claim: SKUAST-K organised a one-day workshop on 'Toolkit for Zoonoses' under the One Health initiative
facts.quote: The Division of Veterinary Public Health and Epidemiology, Faculty of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry (FVSc & AH), SKUAST-K, organised a one-day workshop on "Toolkit for Zoonoses" under the One Health initiative, focusing on the prevention, diagnosis and control of zoonotic diseases through scientific awareness and practical training.

facts.claim: Prof. Sabia Qureshi, Associate Dean, FVSc & AH, attended as Chief Guest and emphasised the need for interdisciplinary collaboration and professional training
facts.quote: Prof. Sabia Qureshi, Associate Dean, FVSc & AH, attended as Chief Guest and emphasised the need for interdisciplinary collaboration and professional training to address emerging zoonotic threats.

facts.claim: Prof. Zia ul Hassan Munshi, former Head, Division of Veterinary Public Health and Epidemiology, highlighted the importance of One Health, zoonoses and food safety
facts.quote: Prof. Zia ul Hassan Munshi, former Head, Division of Veterinary Public Health and Epidemiology, highlighted the importance of One Health, zoonoses and food safety in safeguarding human health.

facts.claim: Dr Najimaana Wani, Senior Assistant Professor-cum-Junior Scientist and Programme Coordinator, highlighted the importance of practical diagnostic skills
facts.quote: Dr Najimaana Wani, Senior Assistant Professor-cum-Junior Scientist and Programme Coordinator, welcomed the participants and highlighted the importance of practical diagnostic skills in veterinary public health.

facts.claim: The technical sessions featured lectures and hands-on demonstrations on key zoonotic diseases and preventive practices
facts.quote: The technical sessions featured lectures and hands-on demonstrations on key zoonotic diseases and preventive practices.

facts.claim: Dr Syed Akram Hussain, Professor and Head, spoke on occupational zoonoses and the protection of farmers, veterinarians and animal handlers
facts.quote: Dr Syed Akram Hussain, Professor and Head, spoke on occupational zoonoses and the protection of farmers, veterinarians and animal handlers.

facts.claim: Dr Mudasir Ali Rather, Associate Professor-cum-Senior Scientist, discussed brucellosis at the human-animal interface and demonstrated serological and molecular diagnostic approaches
facts.quote: Dr Mudasir Ali Rather, Associate Professor-cum-Senior Scientist, discussed brucellosis at the human-animal interface and demonstrated serological and molecular diagnostic approaches.

facts.claim: Dr Najimaana Wani addressed foodborne zoonoses and farm-to-fork food safety, with a demonstration on the isolation and identification of foodborne pathogens
facts.quote: Dr Najimaana Wani addressed foodborne zoonoses and farm-to-fork food safety, with a demonstration on the isolation and identification of foodborne pathogens.

facts.claim: Dr Shabu Shoukat, Assistant Professor-cum-Senior Scientist, discussed mastitis management and demonstrated field screening and laboratory diagnostic techniques
facts.quote: Dr Shabu Shoukat, Assistant Professor-cum-Senior Scientist, discussed mastitis management and demonstrated field screening and laboratory diagnostic techniques.

facts.claim: Dr Innas Yousuf, Contractual Lecturer, demonstrated the collection, transportation and handling of samples for zoonotic disease diagnosis
facts.quote: Dr Innas Yousuf, Contractual Lecturer, demonstrated the collection, transportation and handling of samples for zoonotic disease diagnosis.

facts.claim: The workshop provided participants with practical exposure to diagnostic and preventive techniques, reinforcing the importance of food safety, occupational health and coordinated One Health interventions
facts.quote: The workshop provided participants with practical exposure to diagnostic and preventive techniques, reinforcing the importance of food safety, occupational health and coordinated One Health interventions.
